g.text: Screen 2 — confirm the order (default driver: Elasticsearch)
Requirements 1 & 2 — the form and the chosen products
Validation stays silent until the first
submit attempt, then re-runs live on
every keystroke. Errors are returned as
Requirement 3 — confirm sends the form to the server
The client sends quantities and unit
prices; it never sends a total. Money a
browser can set is money a browser can
Requirement 4 — the server stores the details *and* the item array
visible to the very next search. Without it
a user could be redirected to the receipt
and get an empty result inside the default
